steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS01415 disc, including SLUS_014.15 and US.GAM.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s release or source-build instructions with your own disc; keep its files available to the player.
